# POPSUGAR

> > POPSUGAR is a lifestyle media company offering beauty product sampling, sponsored content partnerships, and community-driven experiences for beauty and lifestyle enthusiasts.

POPSUGAR operates multiple platforms including POPSUGAR Dabble, a beauty product sampling community where users can discover and try new products. The site features brand partnerships with companies like Crest 3D White, delivering sponsored beauty content, tips, and seasonal product offerings to its audience.

## Key Topics

- POPSUGAR Dabble
- Beauty product sampling
- Account creation and signup
- User profiles and email subscriptions
- Crest 3D White partnership
- Sponsored beauty content
- Beauty tips and quick fixes
- Holiday beauty products
- Halloween Boo Kit
- Community-driven beauty discovery
- Brand partnerships

## POPSUGAR Dabble Community

- [POPSUGAR Dabble](https://dabble.popsugar.com/account/new): POPSUGAR Dabble account signup for beauty product sampling community

## Brand Partnerships & Sponsored Content

- [Crest | PS](https://crest.popsugar.com/): Crest 3D White sponsored content and beauty tips partnership with PopSugar
